t: A tiny industrial Linux computer with an Arduino brain riding along.
steps: Buy the Portenta X8 from the Arduino Store or a distributor such as DigiKey.
Pick a carrier board such as the Portenta Breakout, Max Carrier or Hat Carrier.
Plug the module into a USB 3.0 port or a proper 5 volt supply with a USB-C cable.
Follow the Portenta X8 user manual on the Arduino docs site to finish the first setup.
Install the Arduino IDE and add the Portenta board package.
Upload the Blink example to the Arduino side.
Try a sample container app on the Linux side next.
meta: Open Board. From $130. A few stores.
